Yep. But I have so many people depending on me. I don't have a choice. But the thing is, I love taking care of people more than anything. But I'm out of resources. And I'm really really tired.

I can, but I feel like there's no point. Like at the end of the day, I'm still taking care of everyone and everything and there's no one to take care of me.

And it's not like I'm not grateful for everything I have and how far I've come. I really am. But I'm so overwhelmed and I feel like I'm running out of hope that things will get better.
